Soft-deleted documents are untested.

crates/db/tests/txn/registry_suite.rs::test_collection_snapshot_isolation_during_deletion deletes the collection outside any transaction and only checks what an already-open reader transaction sees, so it covers neither behaviour here. Untested: a delete in a committed transaction (delete_collections_in_txn has no test) removing the collections, and other transactions still seeing them in GetCollections before that commit.
